reason: 5.22.2 fixes the approval pause shipped 2026-08-12: every pause window button on /policies and /approvals returned Internal server error because the route wrote its state through upsertSetting and DASHCLAW_APPROVAL_PAUSE was never added to VALID_SETTING_KEYS - the write was rejected as an invalid key.
